digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow cancellation and job routing
propositions: Job-level always() predicates on seven full-route jobs remain true during workflow cancellation, preventing GitHub from canceling superseded matrix and reusable jobs.
Stale full-route jobs must be canceled when a same-change replacement patchset is submitted, not preserved until natural completion.
Docs-only classifications must continue to fail closed: classifier failures launch full-route fallback jobs as blocking results while superseding-patchset cancellations must not.
Full-route job predicates must replace only the cancellation status portion with !cancelled() checks, preserving existing clear-vote, ticket, classifier-result, and route condition logic.
The vote and finalization jobs must preserve cancellation-aware behavior to normalize and report canceled workflow runs.
Live same-change replacement evidence must demonstrate prompt stale job cancellation and unblocked successor job creation without waiting for natural matrix completion.
